**A Snapshot of Your Day

**Join us as a Regional Commodity Manager and become a vital procurement partner for business stakeholders across Northern Europe, focusing primarily on the Danish market. In this dynamic role, you will lead the implementation of procurement strategies, governance, and sourcing initiatives while managing supplier relationships. You will collaborate closely with the Indirect Materials organization, identifying commercial opportunities and contributing to sourcing strategies that drive value through supplier optimization and cost improvements. Engage with regional procurement teams, global commodity managers, and suppliers to enhance procurement performance and create a sustainable business impact.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**

• Drive regional procurement initiatives and implement global sourcing strategies across Northern Europe, particularly in Denmark.

• Develop and execute sourcing, tendering, negotiation, and contract management activities.

• Analyze spending, supplier, and market data to uncover savings opportunities and optimize supplier portfolios.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partner to ensure supply continuity and support business objectives.

• Promote procurement governance and compliance while monitoring supplier performance and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

**What You Bring

**

• A Master’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in procurement, category management, or strategic sourcing within an international and matrix-based organization.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with a balance of strategic thinking and pragmatic execution.

• Experience in indirect materials procurement and supplier management, with knowledge of procurement governance and buying channel strategies.

• Fluent English skills are required; additional Nordic language skills are a plus.

**About The Team

**You will be part of Siemens Energy’s Procurement organization, joining a collaborative team focused on indirect materials. This role offers a unique opportunity to bridge regional procurement leadership and commodity management. You will enhance stakeholder engagement while supporting the development and implementation of category strategies within Office & Factory Supplies. Together with colleagues across Procurement and our BPO partner, you will contribute to Siemens Energy’s procurement transformation, driving standardization, digitalization, and sustainable value creation.

**Who is Siemens Gamesa?

**Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community.

At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking talented individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

**Our Commitment to Diversity

**Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits

**Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave

• Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform

• Access to a variety of employee resource groups

**Application

**Don’t hesitate to apply before the 10th November 2026. Ongoing selection is applied; the role might be filled before the last application date.

Location: Vejle, Ballerup or Brande DK.

_Copenhagen, Denmark

_**About The Job

**Do you want to work with data engineering, platform development, and data-based automated processes within Saxo's Financial Crime Prevention (FCP)? Saxo is an investment bank with high speed, global colleagues, and a strong focus on using technology and data to prevent financial crime. We are looking for a Senior Software/Data Engineer to join the FCP Modelling & Development team.

FCP Modelling & Development is part of the 1st Line of Defence in Group Operations and is located in Saxo's headquarters in Hellerup. The team works with models and data-based automated processes used across FCP. The goal is to ensure that these data assets and processes are sound, fit for purpose, adequately documented, secure, and regularly reviewed.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build, operate, and continuously improve reusable AML data products, data-modelling components, and user-facing interfaces, with clear ownership, lineage, documentation, quality controls, and production reliability.

• Design robust ETL pipelines and integration interfaces for operational, analytical, model-development, and external-platform use cases, enabling secure and efficient data exchange across internal and external systems.

• Translate FCP and AML requirements into durable, adaptable production systems, contributing to solution architecture decisions on design patterns, system scalability, regulatory compliance, and flexibility across AML processes.

• Partner with FCP and AML subject-matter experts on transaction monitoring, customer segmentation, scenario development, client risk rating, surveillance support, and AML-related development initiatives that strengthen financial crime prevention capabilities.

• Define automated checks for completeness, consistency, validity, reconciliation, source-to-target integrity, architectural integrity, security, performance, and governance standards.

• Own observability, alerting, incident response, backfills, runbooks, performance tuning, production support, and operational resilience for critical data assets.

• Raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, mentoring, reusable patterns, clean and well-documented code, test-driven development, secure coding practices, CI/CD pipeline optimization, automated testing, and continuous improvement.

**Your profile

**

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, data-platform engineering, or a related production data role.

• Strong Python, SQL, and Spark skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and data models.

• Practical experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Kafka, Snowflake, Airflow, Azure, or similar technologies.

• Experience supporting ML workflows, including feature engineering, feature data preparation, dataset versioning, reproducible training and validation datasets, model-validation support, and production-ready model inputs.

• Deployment skills for production workloads, including CI/CD, containerized services, and Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms.

• Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, data access controls, encryption, secure handling of sensitive data, and practical data-security patterns using Azure services such as Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Managed Identities.

• Hands-on experience maintaining production data pipelines, including data quality testing, reconciliation, lineage, metadata management, documentation, monitoring, and operational controls.

• Experience with financial crime prevention in regulated financial services, including AML, KYC/CDD/ODD, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, client risk rating, and market-abuse surveillance support.

• Experience with GDPR-sensitive data, audit evidence, regulator-facing reporting, or data governance in control-heavy environments

**Nice To Have

**

• Experience with data quality validation tools e.g. Great Expectations (GX), dbt‑expectations, Soda, Deequ, or Microsoft Fabric.

• Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Location: Søborg, Denmark

Department: Congresses, Product & Portfolio Strategy

**Your impact begins here

**As Congress Strategy & Execution Manager, you will lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of global medical congresses within Speciality Care, turning medical objectives and congress strategies into impactful tactics and experiences.

You will ensure that medical content, congress activities, project teams, budgets, vendors and stakeholders are brought together to ensure our medical presence is delivered on time, on budget and in full compliance. From early planning through onsite execution, you will have the overall view of medical congress activities and act as a key point of contact for medical teams, leadership and other internal and external stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an experienced project manager who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, manage multiple priorities and ensure successful execution. You will bring:

• A Master’s degree, preferably in a life science-related field to relate to the science behind when working with the medical stakeholders

• Minimum 3-4 years of experience in event planning or related roles, with experience planning and delivering complex events or congresses, including management of logistics, vendors and budgets.

• Experience working in highly regulated environments, with a strong understanding of compliance and legal requirements.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

• Strong stakeholder management and indirect leadership skills, with the ability to build alignment and influence stakeholders with different perspectives.

• Excellent communication, presentation and persuasion skills.

• A strategic and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify risks, solve problems and adapt quickly when circumstances change.

• Willingness to travel (US and Europe) approximately 10–15 days per year.

**What You’ll Do

**You will hold end-to-end responsibility for medical activities within your Specialty Care congresses, ensuring they support the individual congress strategy and medical objectives. You will:

• Lead the planning and execution of medical activities at congresses together with the medical teams, translating medical objectives into clear and impactful tactics.

• Maintain an overview of all medical congress activities, guiding project managers responsible for individual deliverables and ensuring alignment across the congress.

• Develop medical congress tactics and oversee medical booth content, together with medical teams, the congress core team and commercial congress lead.

• Manage congress budgets, vendors, contracts and logistics, identifying risks and resolving operational challenges before and during congresses.

• Act as the primary point of contact for Specialty Care stakeholders and the onsite go-to-person for medical teams and leadership.

• Guide project teams on industry practices and opportunities to showcase medical data in impactful ways while meeting compliance and quality requirements.

• Identify and implement improvements to congress processes, workflows, tools and ways of working, while sharing best practices with colleagues.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Congress Strategy & Execution team in Strategic Scientific Communication area, working in a global and highly cross-functional environment.

You will partner closely with medical teams, congress commercial leads and cross-functional core project teams, as well as colleagues across International Operations and US Operations, regions and affiliates, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance and Procurement. You will also interact with senior and executive management.

Externally, you will work closely with agencies, vendors, suppliers and congress organisers.

With congresses taking place worldwide, you will work with stakeholders across geographies and functions. Your ability to create clarity, bring different perspectives together and keep teams focused on the overall congress ambition will be important to delivering a strong medical congress presence.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will take ownership of complex, global congress activities and have the opportunity to shape not only how individual congresses are delivered, but also how we continuously improve the way we work.

You will have a high degree of autonomy and decision-making responsibility, while collaborating with experienced colleagues across medical, commercial and operational teams. You will also have opportunities to introduce new ideas, share best practices and help colleagues grow by bringing innovative approaches to congress planning and execution.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn medical strategy into impactful global congress experiences and bring teams together to deliver them successfully, apply for the Congress Strategy & Execution Manager role by 17 November.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Pandektes is building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world. Behind it is a backend that has to ingest, structure and search a huge database of legal information.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us making sure that the legislation and volume of data stays stable so we can scale our services so we can ingest larger volumes of data, more efficiently.

We have recently closed our Series A round and joining now means you will have a big impact how we grow in the future. This role is based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Experience integrating AI technologies like OpenAI and Pinecone into production systems to build innovative, data-driven solutions. Experience with vector databases, transformers, NLP and LLMs is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

What we value

“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

💰 **Salary, based on experience level:

**🇬🇧 London - up to £92 000 a year/gross

🇩🇰 Copenhagen - up to 74 000 DKK a month/gross

**Intro

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We're looking for a Solution Engineer who's ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins. You'll be the technical partner to our Sales team: you work out what customers need, show them how Monta solves it, and make sure what we sell can be delivered.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Win the technical decision — be the reason charge point operators, energy companies and fleet owners choose Monta to run their charging business.

• Make sure what we sell gets delivered — the commitments made during the sale are realistic and land cleanly with our implementation team.

• Shape the product — turn what you hear from customers into clear input that Product and Engineering can act on.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead technical discovery — understand the customer's business, their current charging setup (platform, hardware, roaming, billing) and what they need to integrate with.

• Run demos built around the customer — tailored to their use cases, not a feature tour.

• Design the solution — define the high-level architecture and integration approach, from OCPP chargers and OCPI roaming to APIs, ERP and energy management.

• Lead proofs of concept and technical evaluations — agree scope and success criteria up front and see them through to sign-off.

• Answer the hard questions — technical, architecture, integration and security questions in meetings, RFPs and security questionnaires.

• Spot risk early — flag gaps and dependencies before a deal is committed, and push back when a promise can't be kept.

• Partner with Sales — on the technical strategy for complex, multi-country deals.

• Hand over cleanly — give the Solution Architect a documented scope so implementation starts on solid ground.

• Close the loop with Product — feed recurring requirements and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.

• Help post-sales when it's busy — for example scoping a migration or running a technical workshop with a live customer.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role — as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer or pre-sales consultant, selling B2B software or platform products.

• You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people — and can go deep with the customer's engineers in the same meeting.

• Your discovery gets to the real problem — you ask the question behind the requirement before proposing a solution.

• You build demos that tell the customer's story — you're comfortable changing course live when the conversation goes somewhere new.

• Hands-on with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, test calls yourself, and explain web-hooks, authentication and data flows.

• Commercial awareness — you understand how deals are won and lost, and you know when to protect scope.

• You write clearly — solution designs, RFP answers and handover notes that others can act on without a follow-up call.

• EV charging, energy or mobility knowledge is a plus (OCPP, OCPI, load management), but not required. We'll teach you the domain.

• You use AI to work faster — for example on RFP drafts, research, demo prep and documentation, and you check the output before it reaches a customer.

• Fluent English, and happy to travel to customer workshops around Europe from time to time.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_****Why Monta

**

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Join IBSA Nordic as Operative Business Specialist and play a key role in operational support and commercial execution within the Dermo Aesthetics business.

Turn ideas into value-creating customer and business-driving initiatives

Reporting to the Nordic Marketing Manager, Mette Busk, you will join the Nordic commercial team in Copenhagen and act as a commercial enabler and project lead, generating ideas and leading key projects with targeted accounts, customer engagement initiatives, and events across the Nordic region, with a strong focus on IBSA’s VALUANCE (Value Through Alliance) concept. You will develop and drive VALUANCE projects with selected Nordic accounts based on segmentation, customer needs, and sales potential in close collaboration with Regional Managers. You will engage directly with customers and co-own selected key accounts from proposal through execution and follow-up. The role also includes planning and executing events, business webinars, and other customer activities, as well as coordinating trade fairs, congresses, and PR activities with the sales and marketing team. In addition, you will conduct and coordinate market research and competitor analyses across the Nordic markets to support commercial decisions and contribute to the development and adaptation of customer-facing marketing materials. Across projects, you will ensure strong operational follow-up and stakeholder coordination. Approximately 60–65 field and travel days per year are expected.

Coordinator with a commercial mindset and strong execution skills

We imagine that you bring experience from a customer-facing commercial role within sales and/or, marketing, event management, or business development, from the pharmaceutical, medtech, healthcare, aesthetics, or life sciences sectors. Accustomed to coordinating multiple projects and stakeholders, you combine commercial understanding, event execution capabilities, sales experience, and solid cross-functional coordination skills. Experience with events, webinars, congresses, trade fairs, or other customer engagement activities is highly relevant. Strong interpersonal skills enable you to communicate fluently in English and one Nordic language, both written and spoken.

To succeed in this role, you are structured, proactive, and self-driven, with a strong focus on execution and attention to detail. Furthermore, you are relationship-driven, take ownership, move initiatives forward, and thrive in a dynamic Nordic environment.

Turn ideas into impact across the Nordics

This is your opportunity to combine commercial thinking with hands-on execution, work closely with customers and colleagues across the Nordics and contribute to the continued development of IBSA Nordic’s Dermo Aesthetics business. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search (www.venaris.dk). For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Executive Search Consultant Lærke Christensen on lc@venaris.dk. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV in PDF format – it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

IBSA Nordic

Established in 2014, IBSA Nordic ApS is part of the international IBSA Group and has built a strong Nordic organization with headquarters in Copenhagen, comprising 35 employees across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, and the Baltic countries, working with the commercialization of pharmaceutical and dermo aesthetic products. Joining IBSA Nordic means becoming part of a cross-cultural organization where collaboration, learning, and development are a natural part of everyday work.

Do you enjoy turning complex data into clear choices that help VELUX use resources wisely? As S&OP Specialist, you will work across functions to develop scenarios and recommendations that support senior management in making key planning decisions.

Meet your future team

You will join Global Planning – S&OP & Planning Excellence, a team that collaborates cross-functionally with Marketing, Regional Management, Supply and Finance to support connected planning processes across VELUX. The team consists of six colleagues based in Skjern and Kolding.

The S&OP Specialist is a new role in the team, introduced to ensure better alignment across functions in the planning processes.

What We Offer

As S&OP Specialist, you will support the Global S&OP process by consolidating market input, preparing scenarios and creating decision material and recommendations for senior management. You will bring structure to S&OP preparation and ensure that agreed decisions are translated into clear planning requirements.

As part of your onboarding, you will be introduced and trained in the current Demand Planning processes and tools to build your understanding of the VELUX supply chain and planning processes.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Ensure that worst/best case sales scenarios is agreed and aligned with the regional management in key markets and understand their assumptions, risk and opportunities.

• Support the global Demand Planning Network in coordinating market input, sales uncertainties, campaigns, allocation requirements and scenarios.

• Plan and facilitate Pre-S&OP meetings and prepare topics that require decisions.

• Develop and evaluate scenarios with Sales, Supply, Purchasing, and Finance, including implications for service, inventory, capacity, production, costs and financial performance.

• Prepare clear decision material for Global S&OP meetings, outlining alternatives, business trade-offs, risks and required decisions.

• Document decisions and follow up on actions, deadlines and outcomes, while translating agreed decisions into input for Master Planning.

This role can be based in Skjern, Kolding, Østbirk or Hørsholm and you can expect minimal traveling in Denmark and abroad.

What You Will Bring Into The Organization

You bring experience from a planning-related role and understand how decisions on demand, supply, inventory and financial priorities connect across the value chain and have translated that understanding into measurable business outcomes.

You combine curiosity and structure with a commercial mindset and business acumen; you can challenge assumptions constructively and connect planning decisions to customer needs, operational trade-offs and financial performance.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring experience from Demand Planning, S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, Supply Planning, Master Planning, Sales Forecasting or Supply Chain Analysis in fast-moving consumer goods.

• Have extensive understanding of S&OP and end-to-end supply chain planning, including how planning decisions affect service, capacity, inventory and production.

• Have advanced Excel skills, experience using Power BI for analysis and reporting, and familiarity with SAP BW/BWP data structures and data extraction.

• Have the financial understanding needed to assess business cases and quantify the implications of scenarios for costs, inventory, revenue and overall business performance.

• Can establish constructive working relationships with stakeholders across functions and levels to ensure that decisions, assumptions, responsibilities and actions are transparent and followed through.

• Can translate data-based scenarios into simple, clear visualisations that enable decision makers to compare options, understand key trade-offs and make informed decisions.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, "courage" and "mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At VELUX, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all - whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

Do you want to keep projects on track through effective coordination and high-quality documentation? Can you combine attention to detail with an overview of tasks, processes and deadlines? And do you have experience supporting project managers? Then join COWI as our new Project Coordinator!

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

We are looking for a Project Coordinator to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects. You will help ensure that work follows the applicable project model and act as a sparring partner to project managers and provide coordination, administrative support and document management across assignments.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Take responsibility for project documentation, including preparing documents, reviewing and revising documentation, and ensuring it is archived in accordance with agreed rules.

• Maintain project registers to support progress and results, and share lessons learned about document management across the organisation.

• Act as a sparring partner to the project manager, assist with financial follow-up, and on your own coordinate, carry out and complete ad hoc tasks to relieve the project manager

• Plan, facilitate and report on workshops, and organise meetings, prepare agendas and write minutes.

• Develop process diagrams and guidance for project participants, and create, design and administer project workspaces.

• Train and support users of project-related tools and prepare status reports and project website content.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarter in Lyngby.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and bring a proactive and positive approach to your work. As the project’s administrative anchor, you are approachable, service-minded and flexible, while standing firm on quality requirements for processes and deliverables. You work in a structured way, maintaining an overview without losing sight of the details. You are curious about new tasks and also comfortable with routine work forming a substantial part of your day.

On top of that, you will have:

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• Experience with document management and an understanding of its importance to project quality and handover.

• Experience from a similar role in project coordination or project administration.

• An aptitude for IT, the ability to work across administrative systems, a good understanding of Microsoft Office and familiarity with SAP

• The ability to organise and see tasks through from start to finish, working with both internal colleagues and external partners.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

**The finance function is broken.

**Finance teams at fast-growing, multi-entity companies are outgrowing their single-entity ledgers and facing a familiar crossroads: bolt on more tools, or go full corporate ERP. Neither option is good. The Frankenstack breaks. The ERP weighs you down with implementation fees and consultants. There has to be a better, more AI native way.

There is. It's Light.

Light is building an AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, and designed to get smarter over time. We call it organic software.

Companies like Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. Following our $30M Series A last year, we're building the team that will make Light the default finance platform for the next generation of businesses.

**Why DACH, why now.

**To win Europe, you have to win DACH. We know this. That's why we're making our first dedicated hire for the region and treating it as a must-win market. You won't be a satellite of a global team running templated playbooks. You'll be a builder. The person who decides what Light looks and feels like in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

**What You'll Be Doing.

**

• Building Light's presence in DACH from the ground up, shaping our GTM strategy, and becoming one of the defining faces of the region. If you'd rather set the direction than follow it, this is your gig.

• Owning the full DACH events calendar. Finhack hackathons, third-party sponsorships, roundtables. From concept to follow-up, you run it.

• Managing the regional budget, knowing where to spend and where to hold back.

• Working with our brand team on everything from regional messaging and localisation to experiential campaigns that cut through in a market full of noise.

• Bringing on-the-ground market data back to your VP Marketing and Growth Lead to sharpen paid activity, targeting, and messaging across the region.

• Driving regional pipeline, working across events, campaigns, and community to build a consistent flow of qualified opportunities for the sales team.

• Partnering with RevOps to keep pipeline clean, prospects moving, and nothing falling through the cracks between marketing and sales.

• Enabling the sales team with the collateral, messaging, and market context they need to win in DACH.

• Building community, not just pipeline. You'll build relationships with press, analysts, and partners, but the bigger goal is an ecosystem of likeminded changemakers around a product that's transforming the finance function.

What we think you'll need.***

**

• Meaningful experience in field or regional marketing at a B2B SaaS company, ideally one that was building out international presence from a non-DACH HQ.

• Native-level German fluency. You can write the copy, run the room, and build the relationships.

• A real track record running field marketing and events from start to finish..

• The ability to work across Sales, RevOps, and brand without losing momentum or creating friction. You know how to get things done in a cross-functional team.

• Genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, not just comfort with it. We're an AI-native company and use AI across everything we build and do. Just as Light helps finance teams do their best work, we expect our people to use AI to do theirs.

• To be based in London, with frequent travel.

• But really, what do we know? If the crux of the role sounds right but you don't tick every box, reach out anyway and make your case.

**The good stuff.

**🏢 In-office culture, with a high talent-density team.

💸 Competitive salary.

🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays in your country of employment.

🚀 The chance to shape a category from the inside, not just market around it.

🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, London, New York, and wherever the action is.

🥳 Company off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

Training Professional – Tablets & Finished Product

**Your impact begins here

**As Training Professional in Tablets & Finished Product, you will make training work where it matters most: in daily production. You will be the first point of contact for training in your area, helping leaders, supporters and operators keep training compliant, clear and practical. Your work supports stable, compliant operations, so the treatments we make for people living with serious chronic diseases are produced to the standard people rely on.

**What You’ll Bring

**You understand how clear standards and disciplined follow-ups, keep daily operations reliable, and you like being close to the people who run them.

• A bachelor’s degree in human resources or relevant field.

• At least 3+ years of experience working with training or training systems, for example as a Training Supporter, Training Coordinator, Training Partner or in a similar role.

• Fluent English and Danish, so you can communicate effectively in both languages.

• The ability to create structure and overview, follow up consistently and turn operational needs into practical training actions.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience from production or a GMP-regulated environment.

• Experience with ISOtrain, Training Tracker, Outlook and Planner.

• A proactive approach: you take initiative and drive activities through to completion.

• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, and comfort acting as a sparring partner who gives advice and raises concerns when appropriate.

• An education in learning science, psychology, human resources or similar.

**What You’ll Do

**You will work close to the line of business, keeping training effective, efficient and compliant while helping the area improve how training is planned, followed up and embedded.

• Act as the primary training contact for your assigned area and give practical sparring to leaders, supporters and operators.

• Be present in daily operations to understand business challenges, and support continuous improvement and problem solving where training is a cause or part of the countermeasure.

• Improve training structures and processes, share best practice and provide training input and documentation for audits and inspections.

• Create transparency on training status, priorities and risks through reporting and regular follow-up with local leadership.

• Support leaders and other roles in using the training systems, Training Tracker and planning tools correctly.

• Keep training compliant and the local training setup running smoothly, through process conformation and consistent follow-up.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Team Training within Production & Business Support (PBS), supporting the Tablets & Finished Product (T&FP) organization at the Måløv site. You will report to Mille Herskind Maltesen and become part of a team of 11 colleagues who work with training and capability development across the area.

Your closest partners will be leaders, supporters, coordinators and operators in T&FP, as well as the wider training organization. In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to bring Novo products to the people who need them, and your role keeps training a dependable part of that work. The team is defining and implementing best practices for how training supports production, and you will help shape them.

For further information, please contact Mille Herskind Maltesen, Manager, Team Training: QHMH@novonordisk.com.

**What You Can Expect Here

**This is a full-time position based on site in Måløv, Denmark, as you will support production every day. You will be trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard, with clear expectations for your work. You will grow through continuous learning and career development, and through close collaboration with colleagues across training and operations.

**What We Offer

**At Novo, you will join a global healthcare company with a distinctive culture and a strong track record. We offer continuous learning, career development and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 570,200 to DKK 838,100, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The compensation package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives, together with other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to take ownership of production projects that help, bring treatments to more people, apply for the Project Manager role 10th November 2026.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Application Engineer, you will help customers turn technical requirements into practical solutions using frequency converters, drives and power conversion technologies.

You will combine technical expertise with commercial understanding, supporting customers from the first technical discussion and pre-sales phase through solution design, quotation, project execution, testing and commissioning.

An important part of your role will be to support marine and electrification applications, including battery energy storage systems, helping customers select, size and successfully implement the right solutions.

Based in Silkeborg, you will join a small, experienced application team where everyone manages their own customers and projects while sharing knowledge and supporting each other.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Partner with our sales team and customers to understand technical requirements and design and size frequency converters, drives and power conversion solutions for customer applications.

• Act as trusted technical point of contact for key customers throughout the customer journey. This includes participating in customer meetings, project scoping and technical clarifications, and translating requirements into solutions and quotations.

• Manage the technical side of projects from pre-sales through implementation, verification testing and commissioning.

• Perform technical analyses such as harmonic distortion simulations, verification tests and evaluations against customer specifications, helping resolve technical challenges throughout the project.

• Share your expertise through technical presentations, product and software-tool training, and collaboration with sales colleagues, service partners and internal technical teams.

The role involves regular customer interaction and travel, primarily within Denmark and potentially Norway and Sweden. You can expect up to approximately 50 travel days per year.

**What We're Looking For

**We are open to different levels of experience. You may already have relevant industry experience, or you may be a recent graduate ready to build your career in a customer-facing technical role. Furthermore, you have:

• A relevant technical background e.g. in Marine Engineering, Electrical or Mechatronics engineering, or a technical trade or service background with extensive electrical understanding.

• A solid interest in motor control, frequency converters, drives and power conversion, with the technical curiosity to develop your understanding of products, systems and customer applications.

• Confidence working directly with customers and different stakeholders, combined with a proactive and structured approach to managing projects and priorities.

• Fluency in Danish and English, as you will work directly with Danish customers as well as colleagues and stakeholders across borders.

• Willingness to travel and work directly with customers and partners on-site when needed.

Experience with marine applications, electrification, drives, power conversion or related industries is an advantage but not essential. Familiarity with Danfoss Drives products or Salesforce is also beneficial.

Most importantly, you bring initiative, curiosity and a willingness to learn. If you are newly graduated, we are interested in your potential and motivation, not just the length of your CV.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll have the opportunity to develop a combination of technical, commercial and project management skills while taking real ownership of customers and projects.

Rather than focusing on only one stage, you can follow solutions from the initial customer requirement through design, implementation and commissioning.

You'll learn from experienced colleagues while building hands-on knowledge of frequency converters, drives, power conversion and electrification technologies, including applications within the marine industry.

The role offers a hybrid working model, with an expectation of being in our Silkeborg office two to three days per week.

You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you enjoy combining technology with customer interaction and want to take ownership of technical solutions from idea to implementation, we'd like to hear from you.

If you're at the beginning of your career, don't let that hold you back. We welcome applications from motivated recent graduates as well as experienced candidates. You don't need to meet every preferred qualification to make an impact in this role.

For more information about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Application Engineering, Daniel Aksel Sandgaard at +45 3010 3176 . For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Lisa Tveen Bachmann, at +45 2859 4039.

Apply and help us turn customer challenges into drive and electrification solutions that move our customers forward.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI
jobs.description:
Department: **Sustainability Data Solutions & AI

**Location: **Bagsværd, Denmark

****Your impact begins here

**As an intern in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI, you will turn sustainability data into insight Novo can act on. You will develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, and help make that data cleaner, more reliable and easier to reuse. Working on real business challenges alongside experienced data analysts and engineers, you will see your work support decisions across the organisation.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are curious, analytical and motivated by using data and technology to solve sustainability challenges. You are a student, and you bring:

A basic understanding of sustainability, environmental data or ESG topics, for example energy, water or greenhouse gas emissions.

Experience with Power BI or another data visualisation or BI tool.

Experience with at least one coding language, such as Python.

An interest in AI, automation and advanced analytics, and in how they can be applied to sustainability challenges.

A structured way of working with a clear eye for detail, and the ability to work independently while supporting those around you.

The ability to explain data clearly to colleagues with less technical insight, with strong written and spoken English.

Familiarity with data engineering, data pipelines or cloud-based analytics platforms, such as Databricks.

Knowledge of statistical modelling, operational research or operations management.

Experience with larger datasets, including data cleaning, transformation, validation or analysis.

**What You’ll Do

**You will contribute to real projects, taking ownership of selected tasks while supporting the wider team’s initiatives. Your work will help strengthen how sustainability data is collected, integrated, analysed and used across Novo.

Develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, turning operational data into actionable business insight.

Support the integration and automation of sustainability data in the Sustainability Data Foundation, including data pipelines and automated recurring reporting and data-quality controls in Databricks.

Improve the quality, transparency and availability of sustainability data by creating clean, reliable and reusable datasets in line with the FAIR principles: Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable.

Support the digitalisation of sustainability data and analytics by connecting sustainability information with relevant business and operational metrics.

Contribute to BI solutions for reporting, forecasting and decision-making, as well as ad hoc analyses across sustainability data and technology.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Sustainability Data Solutions & AI team, part of the Sustainability Strategy and Insights department. The team of data analysts and data engineers drives data analytics on the sustainability agenda for Novo. The department has eight colleagues at headquarters, two in Poland and two in Bangalore, India, so you will work with colleagues across locations.

You will also work closely with stakeholders across Novo who are helping to implement the sustainability strategy across the value chain. Your manager will be [insert hiring manager name]. You will move work forward by bringing technical depth and clear communication together, from deep dives into the data to conversations with colleagues who are less familiar with it.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work on real business challenges, with room to take ownership and make your voice heard. You will learn from experienced data and sustainability professionals, build practical skills in tools such as Databricks and Power BI, and see how data and AI are applied to sustainability across a global organisation. The pace is fast, and you will be supported to perform at your best.

If allowed by your educational institution, the internship is paid at a fixed monthly base rate of DKK 15,900, plus a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn sustainability data into insight and progress, apply for the Internship in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI by November 20, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Do you have respect for customers and colleagues as well as the desire and ability to work professionally in teams?

Verifi

Verifi is a small company with large clients. We emphasise respect for customers and colleagues, as well as the desire and ability to work professionally in teams.

We have an informal tone and place importance on a good social life in the workplace. For instance, we have an annual trip to Data Saturday abroad.

If you are unsure whether Verifi is the right fit for you, contact Kaare Thyregod at +45 41 42 15 68 or on email ktm@verifi.dk. We can have a non-binding and confidential conversation on Teams or over the phone.

At Verifi we offer

Professional work environment

A professional work environment with a focus on knowledge sharing and personal development

Personal development

A personal development and education plan

An informal tone

An informal tone and a daily routine where you share responsibility for tasks

Great benefits

Extra holidays, lunch scheme, pension plan, health insurance, and the possibility for remote work

Office space

Newly renovated offices by Østerbro, within walking distance from the S-train. Free parking

Annual bonus

A bonus model where, for example, a good annual result for the company also benefits you

Community and Learning Events

Social and professional activities, both in smaller groups and through participation in larger conferences, such as Data Saturday, in Denmark and abroad.

BI consultant at Verifi

Working at Verifi

At Verifi, you will become part of a dedicated and highly skilled team that values knowledge sharing, development, and collaboration. We foster a work environment where professional growth and learning are prioritised—whether through certifications or by drawing on the experience of your colleagues.

You will primarily work from our office by Østerbro as well as from your home office. We take a flexible approach to work-life balance and respect your personal circumstances—whether you are part of a young family or have other commitments.

Most of our employees work in small teams, delivering projects for one or more clients. Our deliveries are managed by a project manager or delivery manager, ensuring clear agreements and a structured workflow so you can focus on your tasks.

At Verifi, we believe that a workplace should be more than just a job. We value community and prioritise social activities such as Data Saturday, foraging trips in Grib Skov, or simply sharing a glass of wine before the holidays.

Does this sound like the right fit for you? We look forward to hearing from you!

Vacancies at Verifi

Microsoft backend developer

Are you passionate about customer-specific BI solutions that make a difference? Do you want to develop in collaboration with skilled colleagues and ambitious clients? Then Verifi might be the place for you! Verifi is growing, and we would like to welcome more backend BI developers on board.

Application

Interested? Send a short letter of motivation and your CV to: ktm@verifi.dk, noting “BI Consultant” in the subject line. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and would like to receive your application as soon as possible.

We encourage everyone to apply regardless of age, gender, religion, or ethnic background.

Applications are processed continuously.

Core Tasks

• Development of data warehouse solutions with Microsoft Technology

• Analysis and design of data warehouse solutions and platforms in collaboration with the client and our other participants

• Breakdown, estimation, and planning of complex data warehouse projects

• Participation in other project activities, including internal testing and client testing/UAT

Are you familiar with the following:

• The Microsoft Fabric platform

• Azure SQL Database and other Azure storage technologies

• Data Factory, Azure Functions, and other transformation and orchestration tools in Azure

• T-SQL

• Tabular models

• Integration via APIs, such as REST API

• A structured and risk-minimising approach to development tasks

• An analytical mindset and a fact-based approach to problem-solving

• Good communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in both Danish and English

We place great emphasis on you having several years of hands-on project experience with a number of the technologies mentioned.

**A Snapshot of Your Day

**Join our Operational Excellence & QHSE team in Ballerup as a Sustainability and HSE Student Worker! In this supportive role, you will gain hands-on experience while assisting experienced colleagues with vital tasks such as data management, documentation, reporting, and project coordination. You will play a key role in measuring and reporting the carbon footprint of our sites, preparing HSE and environmental data, and researching emerging HSE topics. Collaborate closely with Environmental Engineers, HSE Managers, and project stakeholders to contribute to safe and environmentally responsible project execution. This position is perfect for a curious and structured student eager to explore sustainability and HSE in real-world energy infrastructure projects.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**

• Support the collection, validation, and analysis of sustainability, environmental, and HSE data for internal reporting and project follow-up.

• Help measure and report environmental footprint data, including carbon-related metrics from Siemens Energy sites.

• Assist in preparing environmental and HSE materials, dashboards, and trackers.

• Maintain project documentation such as environmental plans, HSE procedures, action logs, and audit findings.

• Contribute to a Zero Harm culture by supporting awareness materials and knowledge sharing across projects.

**What You Bring

**

• You are currently pursuing a degree in sustainability, environmental management, environmental engineering, climate, or a related field.

• Sustainability and environmental topics are integral to your curriculum.

• You possess strong analytical skills and enjoy working with data, documentation, and attention to detail.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or similar tools is a plus.

• Experience in gathering data for environmental footprint calculations is advantageous.

• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken; Danish is a plus.

• You are curious, proactive, and eager to learn, with the ability to take ownership of tasks.

• You are structured, detail-oriented, and capable of coordinating multiple smaller tasks simultaneously.

• Ideally, you are in the first year of your Master’s degree, but motivation and fit are most important.

**About The Team

**As part of our Operational Excellence and QHSE team in Ballerup, you will collaborate closely with Environmental Engineers and HSE Managers. The wider project team includes project managers, technical project managers, contract managers, project planners, engineers, site managers, and other specialists located in Denmark and globally across Siemens Energy. Our team supports the global competence center for complete offshore high-voltage systems, connecting offshore wind farms to the onshore grid, serving wind farm owners, shipyards, and EPCs worldwide. Together, we enable a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid, which is the backbone of the energy transition.

**Who is Siemens Energy?

**At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: Siemens Energy Employee Video

**Our Commitment to Diversity

**Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits

**Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave

• Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform

• Access to a variety of employee resource groups

**Application

**Don’t hesitate to apply before the 19th November 2026. Ongoing selection is applied; the role might be filled before the last application date.

Location: 2750 Ballerup, DK.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Join Our Team as **Student Assistant - Procurement

**Put your studies into practice as a Student Assistant in our Procurement team. Gain hands-on experience with data analysis, suppliers, and procurement processes while supporting an international organization.

**Your Role And Responsibilities

**

• Procurement excellence: Support improvements to procurement processes, procedures, templates, workflows, and reporting.

• Indirect procurement: Support sourcing activities by collecting quotations, comparing offers, and following up with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

• Data and insights: Prepare reports, analyse data, and identify spending patterns, data gaps, and improvement opportunities.

• Procurement master data: Collect, maintain, and validate supplier, contract, and purchasing data, including questionnaires, certificates, and supplier records.

• Team support: Assist the Procurement team with supplier documentation, follow-up activities, and other operational tasks as needed.

**What You Bring To The Team

**

• Relevant studies: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree within supply chain, business, economics, or a related field.

• Analytical mindset: Comfortable working with data and turning it into useful insights.

• Digital skills: Comfortable with Excel and interested in developing Power BI skills. ERP experience is an advantage.

• Working style: Proactive, curious, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating with others.

• Communication: Confident written and spoken English

**What You Will Gain

**Develop your analytical and coordination skills alongside experienced colleagues. Gain practical procurement and supplier experience in an international environment - a strong foundation for your future career.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

jobs.occupation: VIKING is looking for a Student Assistant for our Legal team
jobs.description:
JOIN VIKING - and become a lifesaver
Are you looking for that perfect place to provide you with the challenges you need to build your skills and reach your potential? Are you looking forward to working in a company with a clear purpose of saving lives and having ambitious goals for the foreseeable future?

If you can say yes to the above then it might be you we are looking for as our Student Assistant in our Legal team. We have a great opportunity within the area of maritime regulatory affairs and International legislation, hereunder sanctions and corporate legal documents. You may also be asked to contribute to work related to GDPR, Sustainability, ESG, business and IT law as a part of our legal team. 

At VIKING, we live by saving lives. We are proud to be a world leading supplier of safety products, solutions, and services to the global maritime industry. shore platforms, ferries, fishing vessels, and superyachts.

Safety is the core in everything we do and our mission to protect and save human lives.

What you’ll be doing 

We are looking for a dedicated student assistant to be an active member of our Legal team. You will need a problem-solving mindset because no day will be the same.

Working closely with your experienced colleagues, you will have a key role planning, coordinating and executing tasks relating to corporate legal functions and supporting Regulatory Affairs. For example, you will be responsible for coordinating various internal and extern fora relevant for our business and supporting our many internal stakeholders with legal material.

Your skills and efforts will be key to successfully:

• Planning, coordinating and executing tasks relating to the legal department and compliance
• Analyse, develop, implement and maintain new legislation, internal processes and policies, locally and globally
• Creation and implementation of local guidelines and on-going re-evaluation of these
• Support to Regulatory Affairs on Intellectual Properties Rights and administration of patents
• Support in legal risk management and sustainability management 
• Navigate in a global organization with many stakeholders and assist them on an ongoing basis
• provide ad-hoc practical and administrative support to your colleagues
You’ll work approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility to adjust to your personal life  – with favourable flexibility around exam periods.

Become a part of VIKING

Student assistants play an important role within the VIKING organisation. Many of our students also complete their internships with us and write their thesis about real-world projects and challenges at VIKING.

When you start your career with us, you will become part of our strong Young VIKING Network which brings together over 40 ambitious trainees, graduates and student assistants. This community is designed to boost personal and professional development including opportunities to participate in social events. Learn more about our Young VIKING Network here.
